newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's TMN '96 net above 7 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's TMN '96 net above 7 bln esc.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator TMN-Telecomunicacoes Moveis Nacionais, a unit of Portugal Telecom, posted a net profit of more than seven billion escudos in 1996, a statement said.
In 1995 TMN posted a loss of 1.349 billion escudos.
TMN said in a statement that turnover was more than 41 billion escudos in 1996, an increase of 80 percent compared with 1995.
TMN said it doubled the number of its clients to 332,263 by the end of 1996, compared with a year earlier.
The company said its results had improved in large part because it had introduced new products to the Portuguese market. (( -- Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254 ))
